defmodule DistCache.NativeBridge do
  @moduledoc """
  JNI bridge for high-performance serialization in distributed cache.
  Uses a Java-based serialization engine via Port for complex object graphs.
  """

  require Logger

  @jni_lib_path Application.compile_env(:dist_cache, :jni_lib_path, "/opt/dist_cache/lib")
  @max_payload_size 1_048_576
  @allowed_classes ~w(java.util.HashMap java.util.ArrayList java.lang.String java.lang.Integer)

  defstruct [:port, :node_id, :serialization_mode, :class_filter_enabled]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    node_id = Keyword.get(opts, :node_id, node())
    mode = Keyword.get(opts, :serialization_mode, :filtered)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{node_id: node_id, mode: mode}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(%{node_id: node_id, mode: _mode}) do
    jni_classpath = build_classpath()
    port = Port.open({:spawn_executable, System.find_executable("java")}, [
      :binary,
      :exit_status,
      args: ["-cp", jni_classpath, "-Djava.security.manager=allow",
             "com.distcache.SerializationBridge", "--mode", "filtered"]
    ])
    state = %__MODULE__{
      port: port,
      node_id: node_id,
      serialization_mode: :filtered,
      class_filter_enabled: true
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def deserialize_from_peer(payload, peer_info) when is_binary(payload) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:deserialize, payload, peer_info}, 10_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:deserialize, payload, peer_info}, _from, state) do
    case validate_and_deserialize(payload, peer_info, state) do
      {:ok, result} -> {:reply, {:ok, result}, state}
      {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp validate_and_deserialize(payload, peer_info, state) do
    with :ok <- check_payload_size(payload),
         :ok <- verify_peer_identity(peer_info),
         {:ok, class_name} <- extract_class_header(payload),
         :ok <- apply_class_filter(class_name, state),
         {:ok, result} <- send_to_jni(payload, state) do
      {:ok, result}
    end
  end

  defp check_payload_size(payload) when byte_size(payload) <= @max_payload_size, do: :ok
  defp check_payload_size(_), do: {:error, :payload_too_large}

  defp verify_peer_identity(%{node: node, token: token}) do
    expected = :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{node}:#{dist_secret()}")
    if secure_compare(:crypto.hash(:sha256, token), :crypto.hash(:sha256, expected)) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized_peer}
    end
  end
  defp verify_peer_identity(_), do: {:error, :missing_peer_info}

  # Constant-time comparison to avoid timing side channels (CWE-208).
  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    if function_exported?(:crypto, :hash_equals, 2) do
      apply(:crypto, :hash_equals, [a, b])
    else
      manual_secure_compare(a, b)
    end
  end

  defp manual_secure_compare(a, b) do
    if byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
      :crypto.exor(a, b)
      |> :binary.bin_to_list()
      |> Enum.reduce(0, &Bitwise.bor(&1, &2)) == 0
    else
      false
    end
  end

  defp extract_class_header(<<0xAC, 0xED, _version::binary-size(2), rest::binary>>) do
    case parse_class_descriptor(rest) do
      {:ok, class_name} -> {:ok, class_name}
      :error -> {:error, :malformed_header}
    end
  end
  defp extract_class_header(_), do: {:error, :invalid_serialization_magic}

  defp parse_class_descriptor(<<0x73, 0x72, len::16, class_name::binary-size(len), _rest::binary>>) do
    {:ok, class_name}
  end
  defp parse_class_descriptor(_), do: :error

  defp apply_class_filter(class_name, %{class_filter_enabled: true}) do
    if class_name in @allowed_classes do
      :ok
    else
      Logger.warning("Blocked deserialization of class: #{class_name}")
      {:error, :class_not_allowed}
    end
  end
  defp apply_class_filter(_class_name, %{class_filter_enabled: false}) do
    {:error, :class_filter_required}
  end

  defp send_to_jni(payload, %{port: port} = _state) do
    frame = <<byte_size(payload)::32, payload::binary>>
    Port.command(port, frame)
    receive do
      {^port, {:data, <<0x01, len::32, result::binary-size(len)>>}} ->
        {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(result, [:safe])}
      {^port, {:data, <<0x02, len::32, error::binary-size(len)>>}} ->
        {:error, {:jni_error, error}}
    after
      5_000 -> {:error, :jni_timeout}
    end
  end

  defp build_classpath do
    Path.join(@jni_lib_path, "*.jar")
  end

  defp dist_secret do
    Application.get_env(:dist_cache, :dist_secret, "default_secret")
  end
end

defmodule DistCache.ProxyHandler do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles cache replication requests arriving through the reverse proxy.
  The proxy adds X-Forwarded-For and X-Cache-Node headers.
  """

  require Logger

  def handle_replication_request(conn) do
    peer_node = get_header(conn, "x-cache-node")
    auth_token = get_header(conn, "x-cache-auth")
    content_type = get_header(conn, "content-type")

    with {:ok, body} <- read_body(conn),
         :ok <- validate_content_type(content_type),
         peer_info <- build_peer_info(peer_node, auth_token),
         {:ok, deserialized} <- DistCache.NativeBridge.deserialize_from_peer(body, peer_info) do
      {:ok, deserialized}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Replication failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp build_peer_info(node, token) when is_binary(node) and is_binary(token) do
    %{node: node, token: token}
  end
  defp build_peer_info(_, _), do: %{}

  defp validate_content_type("application/x-java-serialized-object"), do: :ok
  defp validate_content_type(_), do: {:error, :invalid_content_type}

  defp get_header(conn, name), do: Map.get(conn.headers, name)
  defp read_body(conn), do: {:ok, conn.body}
end

defmodule DistCache.ClusterSync do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages cluster synchronization. When a new node joins, it receives
  a full cache dump from the leader using the native serialization bridge.
  Class filtering is always enforced regardless of context.
  """

  def full_sync(leader_node) do
    case request_dump(leader_node) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        peer_info = %{node: Atom.to_string(leader_node), token: generate_internal_token(leader_node)}
        DistCache.NativeBridge.deserialize_from_peer(payload, peer_info)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp request_dump(leader_node) do
    case :rpc.call(leader_node, DistCache.Store, :dump_binary, []) do
      {:badrpc, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      data -> {:ok, data}
    end
  end

  defp generate_internal_token(node) do
    secret = Application.get_env(:dist_cache, :dist_secret, "default_secret")
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{node}:#{secret}")
  end
end
